title.english: The Door on the Far Bank

pairs.target: dùchuán cóng jiù hú xià jīngguò shí , tǎ wéi xiān rèncuò le zìjǐ zhù de kèzhàn .
pairs.english: As the ferry passed beneath the old arch, Tavi first misidentified his own inn.
pairs.hanzi: 渡船从旧弧下经过时，塔维先认错了自己住的客栈。

pairs.target: cóng shuǐmiàn kàn guòqù , zhènshàng de wūzi quán dié zài yìqǐ , chuāngqián nàgēn zǒng guà yīfu de gān bújiàn le , yánjiǎo què duō dé xiàng shuí jiāng yìbǎ zhéchǐ zhǎnkāi .
pairs.english: From the water the houses piled together, the pole always hung with laundry vanished, and eaves multiplied like an unfolding ruler.
pairs.hanzi: 从水面看过去，镇上的屋子全叠在一起，窗前那根总挂衣服的杆不见了，檐角却多得像谁将一把折尺展开。

pairs.target: tā jǔ shǒuzhǐ le bàntiān , yù hé cái shuō nà shì mài bù pù , búshì tāmen de chuāng .
pairs.english: After he pointed for a while, Yuhe said that was the cloth shop, not their window.
pairs.hanzi: 他举手指了半天，郁禾才说那是卖布铺，不是他们的窗。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zuòzài lìngyìbiān , bǎ tú tǒng hù zài liǎng xī zhījiān , xiào zhe jiào tā bié wèile zhǎo chuáng , bǎ zhěngtiáo chuán dài wāi .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng sat opposite guarding the drawing tube between his knees, joking that looking for his bed must not tip the whole boat.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡坐在另一边，把图筒护在两膝之间，笑着叫他别为了找床，把整条船带歪。

pairs.target: tāmen zǒu de shì hái zài yòng de xiàyóu dùkǒu . shàngcéng cháng kuà réng fēng zhe , dào duìàn dé xiān yánhé xiàqù , guò shuǐ yǐhòu zài shùn pō shàngxíng .
pairs.english: They used the active downstream ferry crossing. The upper long span remained closed, so reaching the far bank meant going downriver, crossing, then climbing the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 他们走的是还在用的下游渡口。上层长跨仍封着，到对岸得先沿河下去，过水以后再顺坡上行。

pairs.target: shū yàn tì tāmen wènqīng jiù dàng hào , zuóyè shāohuà láishuō , duìàn liú zhe yífèn jiē jià tú , kěyǐ qù kàn ;
pairs.english: Shuyan had checked the old archive number for them and sent word last night that a connecting-frame drawing remained across the river for them to inspect.
pairs.hanzi: 舒砚替他们问清旧档号，昨夜捎话来说，对岸留着一份接架图，可以去看；

pairs.target: zhè cái yǒu le jīnrì zhè tàng gōngchāi , búshì tǎ wéi zìjǐ bèizhe zhǐ qù pèngyùnqì .
pairs.english: That was why today's official trip existed, not Tavi setting out with papers to try his luck.
pairs.hanzi: 这才有了今日这趟公差，不是塔维自己背着纸去碰运气。

pairs.target: chuán zài xià tóu ràowān , jiù hú yìdiǎndiǎn cóng tóudǐng piānxiàng shēnhòu .
pairs.english: As the boat rounded a bend below, the arch slowly shifted from overhead to behind them.
pairs.hanzi: 船在下头绕弯，旧弧一点点从头顶偏向身后。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái kànjiàn lìng yí àn de shízuò búshì wánzhěng de yìdǔ qiáng , bèimiàn liú zhe jǐcéng tuì jìnqù de píngtái , wūzi cháng zài píngtái zhījiān , liàng bù bèi fēngchuī dé gǔqǐ , xiàng zhènzǐ yě gēnzhe zài hūxī .
pairs.english: Only then did Tavi see the far base was no solid wall: recessed platforms stepped back behind it, houses growing between them, drying cloth billowing as though the town breathed too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才看见另一岸的石座不是完整的一堵墙，背面留着几层退进去的平台，屋子长在平台之间，晾布被风吹得鼓起，像镇子也跟着在呼吸。

pairs.target: chuánfū shuō nàbiān jiào shā dēng , yǐqián bóchuán wǎn le , huì yán shíjiē bǎi dēng . rújīn mǎtóu yí dào xià tóu , jiù míng dǎo méi gǎi . tǎ wéi wèn yèlǐ hái bǎi bu bǎi , chuánfū shuō shuí yǒu gōngfū bǎi nàme duō , zìjǐ huíjiā yě dé yǒurén xiān bǎ fàn rè shàng .
pairs.english: The boatman called it Sandlamp: once, lamps lined the steps for late boats. The dock had moved downstream, but the old name remained. Tavi asked if they still did that at night. Who had time for so many, the boatman said; even his supper needed someone to warm it first.
pairs.hanzi: 船夫说那边叫砂灯，以前泊船晚了，会沿石阶摆灯。如今码头移到下头，旧名倒没改。塔维问夜里还摆不摆，船夫说谁有工夫摆那么多，自己回家也得有人先把饭热上。

pairs.target: shàngàn hòu , yù hé xiānmǎi le liǎnggè kǎobǐng , bāi gěi tāmen .
pairs.english: After landing, Yuhe bought two baked flatbreads and broke them to share.
pairs.hanzi: 上岸后，郁禾先买了两个烤饼，掰给他们。

pairs.target: pōdào ràoguò yípiàn gāng jiāoshuǐ de cài , ní lǐ yǒu háizi cǎi de xiǎojiǎoyìn , pángbiān lì zhe yìzhī dùzǐ wāi de táo shòu , zuǐlǐ chā le gēn bōtǔ de xiǎo gùn .
pairs.english: The path skirted freshly watered vegetables, little children's footprints in the mud. A crooked-bellied clay beast stood beside them with a soil-scratching stick in its mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 坡道绕过一片刚浇水的菜，泥里有孩子踩的小脚印，旁边立着一只肚子歪的陶兽，嘴里插了根拨土的小棍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le liǎngyǎn , juéde zhè dōngxī ruò ràng pà wò jiàndào , duōbàn yào tì tā ān gè néngdòng de xiàbā .
pairs.english: Tavi thought Pavo would probably give it a moving jaw if he saw it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了两眼，觉得这东西若让帕沃见到，多半要替它安个能动的下巴。

pairs.target: cún tú de wūzi zài jiù kù hòu . kàn wū lǎofù cóng chuāng lǐ tàntóu , xiān wèn tāmen chī guò méiyǒu , tīngjiàn chī le , cái bǎmén bōkāi , shuō dèngzǐ shàng nà zhī wǎn biépèng , māo zhèng děng zhe chī .
pairs.english: The drawing room stood behind the old storehouse. Its elderly keeper leaned from the window to ask if they had eaten, then opened the door and warned them not to touch the bowl on the stool; the cat was waiting for its meal.
pairs.hanzi: 存图的屋子在旧库后。看屋老妇从窗里探头，先问他们吃过没有，听见吃了，才把门拨开，说凳子上那只碗别碰，猫正等着吃。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dītóu , guǒrán yǒu zhī shòu māo dūn zài dèng xià , yǎnshén bǐ tāmen gèng xiàng lái tǎozhài de .
pairs.english: Tavi looked down. A thin cat indeed crouched below, looking more like a debt collector than they did.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低头，果然有只瘦猫蹲在凳下，眼神比他们更像来讨债的。

pairs.target: jiù tú yǐjīng tān hǎo , shàngtóu yā zhe jǐkuài xǐjìng de xiǎoshí . tú biān quē le yìjiǎo , zhōngjiān què bǐ péi lǎorén nà zhāng duō le yípiàn zhéjìnqù de zhǐ .
pairs.english: The old drawing lay open under washed pebbles, a corner missing but an extra folded sheet in the middle compared with Old Pei's copy.
pairs.hanzi: 旧图已经摊好，上头压着几块洗净的小石。图边缺了一角，中间却比裴老人那张多了一片折进去的纸。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng xiān duì dàng hào , lǎofù gěi tā kàn zhǐbèi , shuō búshì yuánlái quán tú , zhǐshì bǔ jiē láng nà yìhuí cóng zǒngtú chāoxià de júbù , bié huíqù shuō tā zhèlǐ cáng zhe zhěngtiáo xiàn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng first checked the archive number. The keeper showed him the reverse: this was no complete original, only a detail copied during a gallery repair; they must not claim she hid the whole route here.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡先对档号，老妇给他看纸背，说不是原来全图，只是补接廊那一回从总图抄下的局部，别回去说她这里藏着整条线。

pairs.target: níng qí liúgěi tāmen yào chāo de dìfāng , yù hé xiān zhǎodào liǎngchù , tǎ wéi zài lìngyícè yā zhǐ .
pairs.english: Yuhe found two of the details Ningqi had requested from them, while Tavi held the paper on the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐留给他们要抄的地方，郁禾先找到两处，塔维在另一侧压纸。

pairs.target: dōng hòu jiān wài de dàokǒu hé jiē láng dōu zài , wǎng wài yòu jiēdào yíkuài cháng tái . cháng tái liǎngduān fēnliè xǔduō xiǎo fānggé , pángbiān yǒu jǐgēn xìxiàn , gēn tā yuánxiān xiǎng de yì zhěnggēn cū liáng bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: The East Waiting Room entrance and gallery appeared, leading to a long platform. Many small squares lined both ends beside fine lines, unlike the single thick beam he had imagined.
pairs.hanzi: 东候间外的道口和接廊都在，往外又接到一块长台。长台两端分列许多小方格，旁边有几根细线，跟他原先想的一整根粗梁不一样。

pairs.target: tā wèn zhè shì shénme , lǎofù kàn le yíhuìer , shuō zìjǐ zhī zhīdào hòulái yǒurén jiāng nà yìbiān fēng qǐlái , zhǐ shàng jiù zì kě bié wèn tā .
pairs.english: He asked what it was. The keeper looked a while, saying she only knew that side had later been sealed; the old writing was beyond her.
pairs.hanzi: 他问这是什么，老妇看了一会儿，说自己只知道后来有人将那一边封起来，纸上旧字可别问她。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méiyǒu lìkè gěi míngzì , jiào yù hé jiāng xìxiàn hé biānshàng de biānhào yìqǐ chāo , náhuíqù duì níng qí de cèdiǎn ;
pairs.english: Ruan Heng did not name it immediately, asking Yuhe to copy the fine lines and nearby numbers together for comparison with Ningqi's measuring points.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没有立刻给名字，叫郁禾将细线和边上的编号一起抄，拿回去对宁岐的测点；

pairs.target: ruò zhī chāo yìpái hǎokàn de gézi , lián zuǒyòu nǎ yìtóu dōu yào chǎo bàntiān .
pairs.english: Copy only a pretty row of squares and even left versus right would cause hours of argument.
pairs.hanzi: 若只抄一排好看的格子，连左右哪一头都要吵半天。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnshǒu bǐ zhe zhǐbiān , hūrán fāxiàn suǒwèi chuāng kǎn de chǐcùn , bǐ zìjǐ cóng shàngmiàn huà chūlái de hái duǎn .
pairs.english: Comparing along the paper's edge, Tavi suddenly found the supposed sill shorter than his drawing from above.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维伸手比着纸边，忽然发现所谓窗槛的尺寸，比自己从上面画出来的还短。

pairs.target: tā fānkāi yuángǎo , shùnzhe kèxiàn zhǎo , cái kànchū hòulái jiā de lán bǎmén cè yě zhē qù le yíduàn . búshì zhè tiáo lù zài zhǐ shàng biànkuān , shì tā nàtiān zhī liáng dào néng zhàn de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Checking the original against incised lines, he saw the later railing also hid part of the doorway's side. The paper road had not widened; he had measured only where he could stand.
pairs.hanzi: 他翻开原稿，顺着刻线找，才看出后来加的栏把门侧也遮去了一段。不是这条路在纸上变宽，是他那天只量到能站的地方。

pairs.target: lǎofù duān lái rèshuǐ , tīng tāmen zhēng yìtiáoxiàn jiūjìng duàn méi duàn , xiào shuō niánqīng shí kùlǐ yǒurén lái bǔtú , yě shì zhème chǎo , chǎo dào tā zuò wán yídùnfàn , zhǐ shàng háishì zhī duōyìbǐ .
pairs.english: The keeper brought hot water. Hearing them debate whether a line broke, she laughed: map revisers in her youth had argued through a whole meal's cooking and added just one stroke.
pairs.hanzi: 老妇端来热水，听他们争一条线究竟断没断，笑说年轻时库里有人来补图，也是这么吵，吵到她做完一顿饭，纸上还是只多一笔。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō yǒushíhòu yìbǐ nándé hěn , tā biàn diǎntóu , jiào tāmen nán guī nán , bié pèngfān māo wǎn .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said one stroke could be difficult. She nodded: difficult or not, don't overturn the cat's bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说有时候一笔难得很，她便点头，叫他们难归难，别碰翻猫碗。

pairs.target: línzǒuqián , tǎ wéi wèn néng bunéng jiāng tú shàng de yìxiǎo duàn zhuǎn xiàn yě chāoxià . lǎofù shuō gěi tāmen kàn jiùshì gěi tāmen chāo , bié sī yuán zhǐ jiù xíng .
pairs.english: Before leaving Tavi asked to copy a short transfer-route section too. The keeper said looking meant copying, as long as they did not tear the original.
pairs.hanzi: 临走前，塔维问能不能将图上的一小段转线也抄下。老妇说给他们看就是给他们抄，别撕原纸就行。

pairs.target: yù hé bāng tā jìxià tú míng , bǔ chāo nà huí de nián yuè hé quē jiǎo de wèizhì , xīmiàn nàtiáo xiàn huà dào zhǐbiān biàn méi le , méiyǒu yízuò wánzhěng de yuǎn chéng hūrán děng zài hòutou .
pairs.english: Yuhe helped note the title, copying date and missing corner. The western line ended at the page edge; no complete distant city suddenly waited beyond it.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾帮他记下图名、补抄那回的年月和缺角的位置，西面那条线画到纸边便没了，没有一座完整的远城忽然等在后头。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn dùchuán zǎi tāmen huílái . shuǐ guāng zài jiù hú bèimiàn tiào , tǎ wéi bào zhe chāo tú , kàn liǎngàn de hòu xíng wū gé zhe gāochù xiāngwàng .
pairs.english: The ferry brought them back that evening. Waterlight danced behind the arch as Tavi held the copied drawing and watched the waiting houses facing each other high on either bank.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚渡船载他们回来。水光在旧弧背面跳，塔维抱着抄图，看两岸的候行屋隔着高处相望。

pairs.target: tā zhōngyú zhīdào yǒu lù shí mén wǎng nǎbiān kāi , què hái xiǎngbùchū zhàn zài nà dào ménwài , huì tīngjiàn shénmeyàng de chē shēng .
pairs.english: He finally knew which way the door had opened when the road existed, yet could not imagine the sound of carts beyond it.
pairs.hanzi: 他终于知道有路时门往哪边开，却还想不出站在那道门外，会听见什么样的车声。

pairs.target: dào mǎtóu shí , luó dí zài děng yìzhī zhuāng tiědīng de lǒu , jiàn tā huílái , wèn yòu dài le duōshǎo bùnéng nálái bāo dōngxī de zhǐ .
pairs.english: At the landing Luodi waited for a basket of iron nails. Seeing him, he asked how much more paper useless for wrapping things he had brought.
pairs.hanzi: 到码头时，罗荻在等一只装铁钉的篓，见他回来，问又带了多少不能拿来包东西的纸。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng tú tǒng wǎng shēnhòu yì shōu , xiān wèn tā zuórì nàliàngchē shì zhóu shùn bushùn . luó dí yí lèng , suíjí xiào qǐlái , shuō shùn dé hěn , zhōngyú yǒurén jìde tā yě yǒu zhèngjīngshì .
pairs.english: Tavi tucked the tube behind him and first asked how yesterday's axle test had gone. Luodi paused, then smiled: very well, and at last someone remembered he had proper work too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将图筒往身后一收，先问他昨日那辆车试轴顺不顺。罗荻一愣，随即笑起来，说顺得很，终于有人记得他也有正经事。

alignment.english: how yesterday's axle test had gone
